metadata.description: Configurable synthetic risk dataset for local testing and demonstration. Contains clearly labelled simulated entities for mixers, ransomware, sanctioned entities, phishing, and high-risk counterparties.
metadata.disclaimer: DEMO RISK DATASET: Strictly for testing and demonstration of risk evaluation rules. These are synthetic test addresses and must never be presented as real-world verified criminal intelligence.

sanctions_simulation.description: Simulated entity on international sanctions watchlists

mixer_simulation.description: Simulated non-compliant fund pooling / anonymization service

theft_simulation.description: Simulated source or recipient of illicitly obtained funds

phishing_simulation.description: Simulated malicious domain and credential harvesting entity

high_risk_exchange_simulation.description: Simulated exchange entity without verified KYC controls

scenario_low_risk.name: Scenario 1: Low-Risk Wallet
scenario_low_risk.description: Synthetic or real test wallet with no matching indicators within the assessment scope.

scenario_flagged.name: Scenario 2: Flagged Wallet
scenario_flagged.description: Synthetic demo wallet directly interacting with flagged-mixer-demo.testnet within 1 hop.

scenario_inconclusive.name: Scenario 3: Insufficient Information
scenario_inconclusive.description: Wallet with unresolvable state, empty indexer records, or incomplete history exceeding allowable confidence threshold.
scenario_inconclusive.reason: Insufficient transaction records to verify fund provenance. Indexer depth incomplete.
